note_en: 连…都… means "even": the thing after 连 is the least expected case, and 都 (or 也) must follow before the verb. 连神都不是永生的 "not even the gods are immortal"; 连太阳和月亮都会消失 "even the sun and moon will vanish." English needs only the word "even," but in Chinese leaving out 都 sounds wrong.
